summary: Alamos Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a material change report dated June 22, 2026, disclosing operational updates at its Young-Davidson and Island Gold District operations. The filing describes two seismic events and storm-related power outages that impacted production, leading to revised second-quarter production guidance of 130,000–135,000 ounces (12% below prior guidance) and higher costs. No M&A, strategic review, capital return, or other special-situation event is present; this is an ordinary operational disclosure of production disruptions.
